title: I vibecoded Dream Theater's drummer
author: rudesssolo
selftext:
After a month of working on this on and off with Codex (GPT Sol/Astra), I’ve managed to get it to a point where it’s… almost decent.

It still needs a LOT of work, especially the movement and animations, but I’m honestly kinda surprised by how it turned out so far.

This is just a personal project, and I don't plan on sharing the code since it literally uses Mike Portnoy’s likeness and Dream Theater’s music.

Anyway, I thought you guys might get a kick out of it. Still very rough, but I’ll probably keep messing with it and see how far I can push it.
